//: Template for the gitignored appsettings.Development.json. Copy it:
DevAuth:Enabled=true auto-authenticates every request as a fake all-roles admin, with
no sign-in screen. Convenient for UI work, but it bypasses the JWT pipeline entirely —
permissions, tenant scoping and the sign-in directory cannot be tested that way.
To test with REAL Microsoft sign-in, do NOT edit this file: run
scripts/run-local-backend.sh (or .ps1), which sets DevAuth__Enabled=false plus the
Entra configuration as environment variables. Environment variables win over this file,
and the script is committed whereas this file is not.
Never put a real secret here. See docs/local-development.md.
//Sync: 0 disables a background sync service. They need the Graph client secret, which is not available locally.
//ConnectionStrings: Ignored in Development — Program.cs uses a local SQLite file (OnCallDb.sqlite in the build output). Kept for reference only.
